defs.def: the part of the body on top of the neck containing the eyes, nose, mouth and brain 头；头部

ex.s: I removed the sticky spider-webs that covered her head and wings.
ex.t: 我清除覆盖在她头部和翅膀上的粘性蜘蛛网。

ex.s: Then, slowly, he began to nod his head.
ex.t: 然后，慢慢地，他开始点头。

ex.s: as clear as day B. off the top of my head
ex.t: 一清二楚  B. 不假思索

ex.s: Interviewer: So, hold your head up, then.
ex.t: 采访者：那么，抬起头来吧。

ex.s: Sometimes it’s good to just smile, nod your head and listen.
ex.t: 有时候，只要微笑、点点头并倾听就好。

ex.s: For a very long moment, this tiny creature looked into my eyes, turning her head from side to side.
ex.t: 很长一段时间，这个小家伙看着我的眼睛，把她的头从一边转到另一边。

ex.s: In the case of emperors, the act required the person to touch their head to the ground.
ex.t: 在皇帝的情况下，该礼节要求人把头触地。

ex.s: I quickly lower myself, ducking my head to avoid    64    (look) directly into his eyes so he doesn’t feel    65   (challenge).
ex.t: 我迅速蹲下身子，低下头避免____64____（look）直视它的眼睛，以免让它感到____65____（challenge）被挑衅。

ex.s: Many people think that positive thinking is mostly about keeping one's head in the sand and ignoring daily problems, trying to look optimistic.
ex.t: 许多人认为积极思维主要是把头埋进沙里、忽视日常问题、试图显得乐观。

ex.s: They are now getting a head start on next year’s toy workload.
ex.t: 他们现在已经开始着手准备明年的玩具制作工作了。

ex.s: Mik was carrying 30 kilos on his head!
ex.t: 米克头顶上扛着30公斤！

ex.s: Its unique feature, from which it gets its name, is the bright red skin on the top of its head.
ex.t: 它的独特特征——也是它名字的由来——是头顶上鲜红色的皮肤。

defs.def: the mind or brain 头脑；脑筋

ex.s: Meaning emerges through a process of social interaction, not of computation, interaction that shapes the content of the symbols in our heads.
ex.t: 意义通过社会互动的过程产生，而非计算——这种互动塑造了我们头脑中符号的内容。

ex.s: The rules that assign meaning lie not just inside our heads, but also outside, in society, in social memory, social conventions and social relations.
ex.t: 赋予意义的规则不仅存在于我们头脑内部，也存在于外部——在社会中，在社会记忆、社会惯例和社会关系中。

ex.s: You can keep your head clear for 4-10 hours after exercise.
ex.t: 运动后你可以保持头脑清醒4到10小时。

ex.s: Emotional intelligence, with its focus or both head and heart, may serve to point us in the right direction.
ex.t: 情商兼顾头脑与内心，或许能为我们指明正确的方向。

ex.s: I promise not to let it go to my head.
ex.t: 我保证不会让它冲昏头脑。

ex.s: I was organising my words in my head when the girl next to me gave me a nudge.
ex.t: 我正在脑海中组织我的词语，这时旁边的女孩轻轻推了我一下。

ex.s: It was full of ideas that were new to me so I spent the summer with my head in and out of that book.
ex.t: 书里满是对我来说全新的思想，所以我整个夏天都沉浸在那本书里，时而读时而想。

defs.def: the size of a person's or animal's head, used as a measurement of distance or height （人或动物的）一头长，一头高

ex.s: A bright red cloud enveloped the animal, and to Mac's relief, it fell back, shaking its head.
ex.t: 一团鲜红的云包围了那只动物，令麦克宽慰的是，它摇着头退了回去。

ex.s: For Jessica, that means   53   plenty of pictures of happy pets, keeping the house   54   and leaving a nice small gift before heading to the next house.
ex.t: 对Jessica来说，这意味着   53  大量快乐宠物的照片，保持房子   54  整洁，并在前往下一所房子前留下一份精美的小礼物。

defs.def: a continuous pain in your head （持续的）头痛

ex.s: Wang serves as head of the Architecture Department at the China Academy of Art (CAA).
ex.t: 王担任中国美术学院（CAA）建筑系主任。

ex.s: To reduce our impact, we can take simple steps: empty the fridge before heading out, and choose sustainable dining options.
ex.t: 为了减少我们的影响，我们可以采取简单的步骤：出门前清空冰箱，并选择可持续的就餐选择。

defs.def: the person in charge of a group of people or an organization 负责人；领导人

ex.s: “Solar projects need to be good neighbors,” says Jordan Macknick, the head of the Innovative Site Preparation and Impact Reductions on the Environment(InSPIRE)project.
ex.t: "太阳能项目需要做好邻居，"创新场地准备与环境影响力减损（InSPIRE）项目负责人乔丹·麦克尼克说。

ex.s: Paul Beer, head of rhino section at Port Lympne, said: “Obviously we're all absolutely delighted to welcome another calf to our black rhino family.
ex.t: 波特·林普恩犀牛部门主管保罗·比尔说："显然我们都非常高兴欢迎另一头小犀牛加入我们的黑犀牛家族。

defs.def: the person in charge of a school or college 校长；院长

ex.s: The head of the language school told the local newspaper that the school is going to send Harvold on a weekend   53    to Dublin with a friend, thanking him for his    54   .
ex.t: 这所语言学校的校长告诉当地报纸，学校将送哈沃德在周末____53____与一位朋友去都柏林，并感谢他的____54____。

defs.def: the side of a coin that has a picture of the head of a person on it, used as one choice when a coin is tossed to decide sth 硬币正面（有人头像）

ex.s: Suggestions to the Head Teacher (1 picture) ·What to change: lunch break, school uniform, ...
ex.t: 给班主任的建议（ 1张照片） ·更改内容：午餐休息、校服、……

ex.s: Staring at the bookcases in my study, packed with so many great books that had remained unread, I heard a loud voice in my head — “Shame on you!
ex.t: 盯着书房里塞满了许多本一直未读的好书的书架，我脑海里响起一个响亮的声音——「你真丢人！」

defs.def: the end of a long narrow object that is larger or wider than the rest of it 较宽大的一端；头

ex.s: I learned this lesson from a（n）（2）     many years ago． I took the head（3）     job at a school in Baxley， Georgia． It was a small school with a weak football program．
ex.t: 多年前我从一个（2）___学到了这一课。我在佐治亚州巴克斯特的一所学校担任主（3）___的工作。那是一所橄榄球项目薄弱的小学校。

defs.def: the top or highest part of sth 顶端；上端
the place where a river begins （河流）源头
the most important seat at a table 上座（桌子旁最重要的座位）

ex.s: “The important thing is that the technologist associates what is happening outside the patient's body with what the patient sees in his head," Ms L'Ecuyer said.
ex.t: "重要的是技术员要将患者身体外发生的情况与患者脑海中看到的内容联系起来，"勒屈耶女士说。

defs.def: the position at the front of a line of people 领头位置；排头
the mass of leaves or flowers at the end of a stem （茎梗顶端的）叶球，头状花序

ex.s: Beautiful year-round, they invite you to enjoy the smallest detail, from the sound of grasses in the gentle wind to the sculpture of odd-looking seed heads.
ex.t: 它们四季美丽，邀你欣赏最小的细节，从微风中草丛的沙沙声到造型奇特的种穗如雕塑般的美。

defs.def: the mass of small bubbles on the top of a glass of beer 啤酒泡沫；酒头
the part of a spot on your skin that contains a thick yellowish liquid (= pus) 脓头
the part of a tape recorder or video recorder that touches the tape and changes the electrical signals into sounds and/or pictures 磁头
（表示农场或牧群等的牲畜的数目）头
the pressure produced by steam in a confined space 蒸汽压力

ex.s: The pressures of "time" and "destination" are further blocks to awareness． I encountered many hikers who were headed to a distant camp﹣ground with just enough time to get there before dark． It seldom occurred to them to wander a bit， to take a moment to see what's around them． I asked them what they'd seen． "Oh， a few birds， "they said． They seemed bent on their destinations．
ex.t: 时间和'目的地'的压力是觉悟的进一步障碍。我遇到许多徒步者，他们赶往一个遥远的营地，刚好有足够时间在天黑前到达。他们很少想到要闲逛一会儿，花点时间看看周围有什么。我问他们看到了什么。'哦，几只鸟，'他们说。他们似乎一心奔着目的地。

defs.def: oral sex (= using the mouth to give sb sexual pleasure) 口交
the central part of a phrase, which has the same grammatical function as the whole phrase. In the phrase ‘the tall man in a suit’, man is the head. （短语的）中心成分，中心词，主导词

ex.s: It was that voice in the back of my head telling me that one phrase that has stopped so many people from reaching their potential: I can’t.
ex.t: 正是我脑海中的那个声音告诉我那个阻止许多人发挥潜力的短语：我不行。

ex.s: Southbank, at an eastern bend in the Thames, is the center of British skateboarding, where the continuous crashing of skateboards left your head ringing .I loved it.
ex.t: 南岸，在泰晤士河向东的拐弯处，是英国滑板运动的中心，滑板不断的撞击声让你的脑袋嗡嗡作响。我爱上了那里。

defs.def: to sleep 睡觉
to make you feel drunk 酒精
to make you feel too proud of yourself in a way that other people find annoying 成功、赞扬等
to be good at sth 擅长某事
if sb does not have a head for heights, they feel nervous and think they are going to fall when they look down from a high place 不惧（高）；无恐（高）症

ex.s: Eva spent the first week of high school trying to keep her head above water.
ex.t: Eva在高中第一周努力让自己勉强维持下去。

defs.def: to be thinking about sth that is not connected with what you are doing 心不在焉；走神
to have ideas, plans, etc. that are not realistic 有不切实际的想法（或计划等）；想入非非

ex.s: Matt Hunt said he was "very proud" of his son because “when the boy gets an idea, he keeps his head down and gets on with it, and he really does want to do some good and stop young kids from getting asthma."
ex.t: 马特·亨特说他为儿子感到“非常自豪”，因为“当男孩有了想法时，他会埋头苦干，坚持下去，而且他真的想做点好事，防止孩子们患上哮喘。”

defs.def: moving forwards or downwards with your head in front of the rest of your body 头在前；头朝下
without thinking carefully about sth before acting 未经深思；轻率；鲁莽
crazy 发疯
not knowing what you are saying or doing because of the effects of alcohol or drugs （酒后或使用药物后）胡言乱语，行为乖张，神志不清
too difficult or complicated for sb to understand 超过某人理解力；过于复杂

ex.s: Dad said she was probably lonely, and that I ought to sit and listen and nod my head and smile, and maybe she’d work it out of her system.
ex.t: 爸爸说她可能很孤独，我应该坐下来倾听、点点头、微笑，也许她能把心里的郁闷发泄出来。

defs.def: to a higher position of authority than sb 职位比某人高；超过某人
to move in a particular direction 朝（某方向）行进

ex.s: I gave the owner as much information as possible and headed home to see what news the night might bring.
ex.t: 我向主人尽可能多地提供了信息，然后朝家走去，看看那个夜晚会带来什么消息。

ex.s: To make sure you get enough Vitamin D—but still protect your skin— put on sunscreen right as you head outside.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 为了确保你获得足够的维生素D——同时保护你的皮肤——出门时立即涂上防晒霜。

ex.s: So, my dad and I put on our new cowboy hats, got on our horses, and headed slowly towards the mountains.
ex.t: 于是，我和爸爸戴上新的牛仔帽，骑上马，慢慢朝山里走去。

defs.def: to lead or be in charge of sth 领导；主管
to be at the top of a list of names or at the front of a line of people 位于排行之首；排在前头

ex.s: Head Chef David Thompson, who received a Michelin star for his Loodon-based Thai restaurant of the same name, opened this branch in the Metropolitan Hotel in 2010.
ex.t: 主厨大卫·汤普森曾凭借其位于伦敦的同名泰国餐厅获得米其林一星，他于2010年在大都会酒店开设了这家分店。

defs.def: to put a word or words at the top of a page or section of a book as a title 在（页或篇章的）顶端加标题

ex.s: With any luck, he’ll turn a few more heads in the process.
ex.t: 运气好的话，他在此过程中还会吸引更多人的目光。

ex.s: At the top of a second page, put the heading “Acts of kindness.” On this one, list all the positive things you’ve done for others.
ex.t: 在第二页的顶部写下标题“善举”。在这一页上，列出你为他人做过的所有积极的事情。

ex.s: Learning to learn As subheadings expand on the main heading or title, they can be slightly longer than the main heading.
ex.t: 学会学习 副标题是对主标题或题目进行展开说明，所以可以比主标题稍微长一些。

defs.def: to hit a football with your head 用头顶（球）

chunks.cn: 大约 保持 在 … 上 头
